command:
cat > /var/jb/var/mobile/e1.plist <<E
<?xml version="1.0"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>com.apple.private.amfi.can-execute-cdhash</key><true/></dict></plist>
E
cat > /var/jb/var/mobile/e2.plist <<E
<?xml version="1.0"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>com.apple.private.security.no-sandbox</key><true/></dict></plist>
E
cat > /var/jb/var/mobile/e3.plist <<E
<?xml version="1.0"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>platform-application</key><true/><key>com.apple.private.amfi.can-execute-cdhash</key><true/></dict></plist>
E
for v in e1 e2 e3; do cp /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/libexec/diskarbitrationd /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/t_$v; /var/jb/usr/bin/ldid -S/var/jb/var/mobile/$v.plist -M /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/t_$v; for H in $(/var/jb/usr/bin/ldid -h /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/t_$v | grep "^CDHash=" | cut -d= -f2); do /var/jb/usr/bin/jbctl trustcache add $H >/dev/null; done; timeout 5 /var/jb/usr/bin/chroot /var/mnt/rootfs /usr/local/bin/t_$v x >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "$v rc=$?"; done
limit: A timeout kills the local SSH process group; remote work may need explicit cleanup.
